text:
Aisha: Quick sync — we need final decisions for the Optimize toolkit sprint. Customers asked for batching + cache + quant recs and eval-triggered alerts. Can we lock launch gates by EOD?
Matt: list the must-haves please. we should avoid scope creep.
Aisha: must-haves: 1) deterministic recommendation API for batching/cache/quant profiles 2) eval-triggered alert plumbing + simple UI hook 3) rollout + rollback policy with automatic fallback to hosted baseline.
Olivia: for eval alerts, propose thresholds: trigger when quality delta > 5% on the canonical prompt set (n=1k) OR when embedding similarity drop > 0.07 for rerank flows.
Sam: customers (esp. fin/health) need an audit log on recommendations + who accepted them. also want recommendation rationale in plain text.
Rachel: +1 on audit log. one pilot customer insists on a manual approval step before recommendations apply to Dedicated.
Matt: implementation notes: batching recs are cheap (heuristic + runtime stats), caching recs need KV-size estimates + prefix reuse heuristics, quant recs require a light guardrail: only suggest quant variants that pass the local fidelity test on a held-out eval.
Olivia: fidelity test = top-3 token overlap + perplexity delta < 3% for generative tasks. if failing, mark as "needs manual review".
Aisha: launch criteria proposal (short):
- Core API + UI for recs available behind feature-flag
- Eval-triggered alerts wired to SRE/Customer success with actionable payloads
- Pilot with 2 customers (one Hosted, one Dedicated) with signed acceptance tests
- Rollout config and automatic fallback live
Matt: I sketched a rollout config — simple YAML to start:```
rollout:
  audience: 10%
  metrics:
    - latency_p95
    - quality_delta
  alarms:
    - quality_delta > 0.05
    - latency_p95 > 1.5x_baseline
  fallback: hosted_baseline
```
Sam: for pilot acceptance tests, can we make a checklist? e.g., run eval suite, validate logs, check SLOs under 95th perc load, confirm manual approval flow.
Olivia: add: run quant-fidelity job: `./run_eval --suite=quant-fidelity --baseline=deterministic-v1` and require pass on 90% of test cases.
Rachel: customer asks re: transparency — send them a CSV of recommended changes and the eval summary each week. They'll sign off if we provide that.
Aisha: product scoping decision needed: do we 1) ship recommendations + passive alerts (no auto-apply) or 2) ship auto-apply for low-risk customers?
Matt: I'd prefer 1 for GA. auto-apply requires extra safety auditing and we don't have HSM/KMS integration gated for some pilots.
Sam: +1 to 1. but allow customers to opt-in to auto-apply via config: `apply_mode: manual|opt_in|auto`
Aisha: show of hands in channel? (react with :thumbsup: for manual-only GA, :rocket: for auto-apply opt-in at GA)
Matt: :thumbsup:
Olivia: :thumbsup:
Sam: :rocket: (would help some big pilots)
Rachel: :thumbsup: (CS wants manual for early pilots)
Aisha: decision: GA = manual-only recommendations + passive eval-triggered alerts. roadmap item to add opt-in auto-apply in Q2 after pilot signoffs.
Aisha: outstanding work: 1) Matt to expose rec API + audit events (action: matt/2w) 2) Olivia to finalize eval thresholds and run quant-fidelity harness (action: olivia/1w) 3) Sam/Rachel to schedule pilot kickoff with two customers (action: sam/rachel/1w) 4) infra: ensure alerting routes to SRE + CS (action: eng-oncall/3d)
Matt: noted. I'll post a minimal API contract later today.
Olivia: will push the evaluation harness and share results.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy to staging for feature-flagged toolkit at 2024-04-18T22:00Z
Aisha: thanks — next sync Fri standup; if anyone blocks, ping me here.
Sam: adding a short-run acceptance script for pilots; will drop in #product-resources.
Rachel: prepping customer comms template.
Aisha: nice, closing this thread once I see the API contract.
